name: Revdoku
description: Publish and update static websites and files. Manage bucket files, versions, access settings, forms, and analytics.
capabilities: Store documents, data, and source files in private cloud buckets
Read, write, and append shared files across authorized AI connections
Inspect versions and change history; restore earlier files
Preview an authenticated bucket draft for 24 hours
Sign up in the browser, then connect an existing account
Publish static websites and SPAs from account buckets
Update an existing website at the same URL
Configure protected access, forms, analytics, and domains on eligible plans
